items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: not like a Guy Lombardo, not like -- but they stressed quality in their band

ctx.x: Oh, yes, but the formation -- I knew some guys that played, they didn't have perfect embouchure but still, they had endurance. But to play high like that, it's a gift. You have to be dedicated to practicing to play higher. So -- and when I was on Jester-Pillar's band, they had more of a smooth band, you had to have tonal quality. You had to really express yourself through playing in a lower part of your horn
because they had a different style of band. They wanted to play something -- not like a Guy Lombardo, not like -- but they stressed quality in their band because they were very good musicians.
Where did they get those names from? Were they Mexicans or something?
